title: How to Breed 12 Palworld Pals | 3 Easy Combos Each | Palworld 1.0 Breeding Guide
description: Twelve Palworld Pals with three breeding combos each, thirty six combos in total, checked against Pindrop and Pal Breed Calc for Palworld 1.0: Foxcicle, Wixen, Sweepa, Loupmoon, Rayhound, Tombat, Swee, Hoodle, Warsect, Turtacle, Needoll and Finsider.
joke: You can build a perfect breeding farm and still wonder why your Pals are sleeping instead of working.

sections.heading: Intro
sections.script: Palworld breeding looks complicated, but you only need the right pair of parents. In this video we go through twelve Pals and give you three easy breeding combos for each one, thirty six combos in total. Every pair was checked against Pindrop and Pal Breed Calc, which both list it as a valid way to hatch that Pal in Palworld one point zero. Breeding results changed a lot in the one point zero update, so older lists from before that can be wrong. We do not use any legendary parents, no crossover Pals, and no pair that depends on gender, so you can use any male or female of the species. Stay until the end for a few tips that make every pair faster, and then pick the combo that uses the Pals you already own.

sections.heading: Before you start
sections.script: Before we begin, here is how to read the combos. Each Pal below has three pairs, and every pair is written as two parent names. It does not matter which one is the mother and which one is the father, because none of these results depend on gender. All three pairs lead to the same child, so you never need all of them, only the one you can build fastest. If you already own one parent of a pair, look at that pair first, because you only need to catch or breed the other parent. If you own nothing from the list, pick the pair whose parents spawn closest to your base. Keep a note of the child you want, check that you have the Breeding Farm unlocked, and then follow the pairs one at a time. Let us start with the first two Pals.

sections.heading: Foxcicle and Wixen
sections.script: Next up. Foxcicle. Combo one: Nyafia plus Bristla. Combo two: Frostplume plus Chikipi. Combo three: Dumud plus Vanwyrm. All three pairs hatch the same Pal, so use whichever parents you already own. Put the pair on your Breeding Farm, and when the egg hatches in your incubator you get a brand new Foxcicle. Then: Wixen. Combo one: Smokie plus Dazzi. Combo two: Nyafia plus Daedream. Combo three: Digtoise plus Caprity. All three pairs hatch the same Pal, so use whichever parents you already own. The steps are the same, and the egg gives you a Wixen.

sections.heading: Why three combos
sections.script: You might ask why we give three combos for each Pal. The reason is simple. Every player has a different collection, and nobody wants to catch a rare parent just to breed one egg. With three different pairs you can usually find one that uses Pals you already own, or Pals that live near your base. Also, the one point zero update changed many breeding results, so a pair that worked before might not work now. Every pair in this video is listed for its child on both Pindrop and Pal Breed Calc, so you can trust them in Palworld one point zero. If one of the sites updates later, check again before you spend your cakes. Now let us continue with the next Pals on the list.

sections.heading: Tips
sections.script: Here are a few tips that make all thirty six combos easier. First, make sure the Breeding Farm is built and both parents are assigned to it, and that you have a cake for them to eat, because the pair will not make an egg without one. Second, check that the parents are not variants or crossover Pals, because the combos in this video use standard species only. Third, after the egg appears, put it in an incubator and wait, since large eggs take longer to hatch. Fourth, if you want better passive skills, breed with parents that already carry the passives you like, because those can be passed down to the child. And fifth, do not rush. Breeding is a slow loop, so queue the pairs and go and do something else while they work.

sections.heading: Your turn
sections.script: Let us end with a joke. In Palworld, you can build the perfect breeding farm and still spend the whole evening wondering why your Pals are sleeping instead of working. Now it is your turn. Which of these twelve Pals are you going to breed first, and which Pal should we cover with new combos next? Tell us in the comments. If this guide helped you, subscribe to HarryBeast Gaming for more Palworld breeding guides, and we will see you in the next video.
